dataset_refs: same frozen exposed eight-task cohort; rounds ten and eleven remain historical
experiment_template.research_question: Does exact accounted-incomplete-output ledger recovery allow the one-shot GLM-5.3-flash 8K matrix to complete and meet its fixed criteria?
stop_conditions: Any shared provider or instrument failure pauses unstarted cells and retains every outcome.
No within-round task, source, prompt, cap, threshold, or state-mechanism change.
The ledger repair is common to both arms and only classifies fully accounted length responses as recoverable.

records.falsifier: The integrated transport/recycler correction is denied, failed tokens disappear, more than one correction is admitted, a genuinely uncertain failure becomes resumable, ledger restore loses accounting, or the complete frozen matrix misses H21 native, validity, token, exposure, or integrity criteria.
records.mechanism: When and only when a model response has HTTP 200, valid complete usage, a bound receipt, and finish_reason length, durably persist the transport ledger as idle before raising typed incomplete-output. The episode retains the receipt and issues at most its frozen one concise correction. All uncertain transport and malformed-response failures remain poisoned.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; one-shot receipt-bound state and typed incomplete-output recovery under cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: Treating a fully accounted GLM-5.3-flash length-limited response as ledger-idle permits exactly one bounded correction and allows the 8K one-shot boundary-state experiment to complete without losing failed-token accounting.

records.research_question: Does exact accounted-incomplete-output ledger recovery allow the one-shot GLM-5.3-flash 8K matrix to complete and meet its fixed criteria?
stop_conditions: Any missing or duplicate recycled-generation presentation, unknown usage, state-cap failure, false fact, false source credit, effect, or correction above one is an instrument failure.
No within-round task, source, prompt, cap, threshold, state-mechanism change, replacement, or lucky rerun.
Pause unstarted cells on shared provider or instrument failure and retain every attempted outcome.
Round-ten and round-eleven outcomes remain historical; every round-twelve cell is a new separately frozen replication identity.

success_criteria.scope: Complete exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K one-shot boundary-state replication; no larger window, untouched confirmation, repair correctness, semantic-retention, transfer, or clearance claim.

records.claim: All 16 cells completed with exact one-shot exposure and known usage, but only 6/8 pairs were scoreable and complete-pair mean state-minus-control span F1 was -0.0021946923387415607 versus the fixed +0.05 target. State used 4505 more model tokens. Benefits on tasks 1, 2 and 4 coexisted with losses on tasks 6 and 8.
limitations: Native evidence selection does not establish repair correctness or semantic retention.
No output-cap correction received live exposure.

records.next_action: Retain the repaired instrument, exact fitting, one-shot delivery, frozen cohort and fixed criteria. Test whether model-facing durable evidence without exploratory tool-outcome chronology removes the observed task-dependent harm. Keep delta state and the semantic-ceiling null as competing hypotheses.
